mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for late morning and evening. On Day 30 at 09:56, it was at kitchen_table_k1, not desk_o1. On Day 30 at 21:25, it was at cupboard_k1, not desk_o1. The "desk_o1" pattern is unreliable for these times. For late morning (09:00-11:00), check kitchen_table_k1. For late evening (21:00-22:00), check cupboard_k1. Continue checking kitchen_table_k1 for early morning (07:00-09:00) and cupboard_k1 for very late night (22:00+).

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested dining_table_d1 for evening. On Day 29 at 18:18, it was actually at desk_o1. The "dining_table_d1" pattern for evening is incorrect. Check desk_o1 for evening queries (18:00-21:00), as Tomas is likely at his desk. Continue checking desk_o1 for morning/afternoon (09:00-17:00).

charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night. On Day 26 at 17:26, it was at desk_o1. The "nightstand_b1" pattern is strictly for very late night (22:00+). For late afternoon (17:00-18:00), check desk_o1, as Tomas may still be at his desk or just leaving. Do not check nightstand_b1 before 22:00.

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested cupboard_k1 for late night. On Day 26 at 22:54, it was actually at nightstand_b1. The "cupboard_k1" pattern is incorrect for late night. Check nightstand_b1 for late night queries (22:00+). For mid-day (12:00-14:00), check kitchen_table_k1, as seen on Day 26 at 12:56. Do not check dining_table_d1 for mid-day.

book_tomas: No new evidence today contradicts previous notes. Continue checking coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00) and bed_b1 for late night (22:00+).
